description: This file defines interfaces and constants for the Android sensors HAL version 2.1, including callback and sub-HAL interfaces, as well as a factory function for loading sub-HAL implementations.

classes.name: IHalProxyCallback
classes.description: Interface for callbacks into the HalProxy to post sensor events and manage wake locks.

classes.name: ISensorsSubHal
classes.description: Interface that sub-HALs must implement to be compatible with the multihal framework.

methods.name: postEvents
methods.description: Callback to send sensor events to the framework, with wake lock management.

methods.name: createScopedWakelock
methods.description: Creates a ScopedWakelock instance, optionally locked.

methods.name: initialize_2_1
methods.description: Initialization method for version 2.1, with descriptors and callback.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initialization method for version 2.0, with descriptors and callback.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Outputs debug information for the sub-HAL.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for the sub-HAL.
